channel.description: Daily news scored for its impact on Agri & fertilisers in Indian markets. Today: mixed (−0.3).

item.title: [−1] Black Sea blockade set to cost Ukraine 30 million tonnes of farm exports
item.description:
Shipping attacks are choking grain and oilseed exports. India is already shifting from sunflower to palm oil. Escalating.

Agri & fertilisers: mild headwind (−1) — World food prices up

Why it matters: Lost Black Sea supply lifts world grain and edible oil prices, raising costs for Indian food makers and food inflation.

Market gauges: Inflation outlook −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: months

item.title: [+1] Ukraine offers elections if Russia agrees a 60-day ceasefire; US presses both sides on refinery strikes
item.description:
Ukraine's president said Russia must also stop energy strikes. India's three-part truce plan covers energy sites and Black Sea shipping. New signs of de-escalation, unconfirmed by Moscow.

Agri & fertilisers: mild tailwind (+1) — Safer fertiliser and grain supply

Why it matters: A ceasefire would ease Black Sea grain, fertiliser and edible-oil supply and Russian fuel flows, lowering India's food and fuel import costs.

Market gauges: Inflation outlook +1

Confidence: low · horizon: weeks
